items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The three popular bands in Baton Rouge were Papa Augustin and Tody(?) Harris

ctx.x: The three popular bands in Baton Rouge were Papa Augustin and Tody(?) Harris, but Toots was number one. Buddy Petit played with that band.
And another New Orleans musician, Johnny Handy, played with him for a while, too.
